actions.headline_en: Boiler 1: steam temperature anomaly. Inspect now.
actions.headline_ms: Dandang 1: anomali suhu stim. Periksa sekarang.

reasons.text_en: Steam temperature has run 18 °C below its normal band for 4 hours
reasons.text_ms: Suhu stim 18 °C di bawah julat biasa selama 4 jam

reasons.text_en: Steam pressure is swinging twice as much as usual
reasons.text_ms: Tekanan stim berayun dua kali ganda daripada biasa

reasons.text_en: Feedwater flow is falling while the mill load is steady
reasons.text_ms: Aliran air suapan menurun walaupun beban kilang stabil

actions.why_rank_en: Boiler stops the whole mill: about RM50,840 of CPO at risk every hour
actions.why_rank_ms: Dandang menghentikan seluruh kilang: kira-kira RM50,840 CPO berisiko setiap jam

actions.headline_en: Press 2: worm wear. Change the worm at tomorrow's 06:00 stop.
actions.headline_ms: Penekan 2: haus skru cacing. Tukar skru pada henti terancang esok jam 06:00.

reasons.text_en: Motor current per tonne is 9% above Press 2's normal for 5 days
reasons.text_ms: Arus motor setiap tan 9% lebih tinggi daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2 selama 5 hari

reasons.text_en: Oil lost in fibre rose to 3.6% (alarm line is 4%)
reasons.text_ms: Kehilangan minyak dalam serabut meningkat kepada 3.6% (garis amaran 4%)

reasons.text_en: Worm has run 1,310 h since the last change; typical life is about 1,200 h
reasons.text_ms: Skru cacing telah beroperasi 1,310 jam sejak penggantian terakhir; hayat biasa kira-kira 1,200 jam

actions.why_rank_en: Costs less than the boiler alert, but the fix is cheap and fits the planned stop
actions.why_rank_ms: Kos lebih rendah daripada amaran dandang, tetapi pembaikan murah dan muat dalam henti terancang

actions.headline_en: Press 4: early bearing signs. Keep watching.
actions.headline_ms: Penekan 4: tanda awal galas. Teruskan pemantauan.

reasons.text_en: Vibration kurtosis has risen for 3 days while RMS is still normal
reasons.text_ms: Kurtosis getaran meningkat selama 3 hari manakala RMS masih normal

reasons.text_en: Gearbox oil temperature is 2 °C above its usual level
reasons.text_ms: Suhu minyak gear 2 °C lebih tinggi daripada biasa

reasons.text_en: Bearing has run 1,850 h since service
reasons.text_ms: Galas telah beroperasi 1,850 jam sejak servis

actions.why_rank_en: One press is a quarter of the mill, so this ranks below the boiler and Press 2
actions.why_rank_ms: Satu penekan ialah suku kilang, jadi ia berada di bawah dandang dan Penekan 2
